infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Yehsa uses your location only after you consent to hold a position.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Yehsa scans for nearby Yehsa peers only after you tap Scan. It does not scan at launch.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription: Yehsa connects to a Yehsa peer you choose. It does not disconnect a link already held.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Yehsa uses the microphone only while you hold or tap to talk on Ask.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Yehsa turns that question into text on this device when the recognizer can do that.
